request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Thornback Hare".

Creative brief
Name: Thornback Hare
Collection: Briarwild Brood. Woodland animals reshaped by an ancient living forest, using thorns, seeds, roots, sap, and leaf-pattern projectiles.
Core concept: A nervous skirmisher that leaves thorn volleys behind each evasive leap.
Body and silhouette: Small crouched hare with long upright ears, oversized hind legs, and an arched thorn-covered back.
Signature features: Thorn ridge along the spine, leaf-shaped ear tips, and glowing green eyes.
Palette and materials: Moss green, bark brown, muted cream, and sharp pale thorns.
Movement personality: Jittery, alert, and explosively quick.
Attack concept: Leaps sideways before firing two narrow thorn lines through its previous position, punishing players who chase directly.
Directional details: The right ear is bent halfway down and must remain bent in every direction.
Avoid: Cute domestic rabbit, realistic fur texture, thorns too small to read.
